name: IB Biology Prep: Genemere
subtitle: IB Biology labs, mocks, IA
shortDescription: IB Biology practice that adapts to you: 549 questions, 10 labs, guided builds, mock papers and an IA coach for SL and HL. Works offline. No account.
longDescription:
IB Biology Prep: Genemere is practice and revision for IB Biology SL and HL. It works offline, with no account.

### What It Is
A study aid with 176 short lessons, 549 original practice questions, 10 interactive labs, 4 guided builds, paper-style mock sets and an Internal Assessment coach. Everything is our own writing, made for revision and practice.

### Syllabus Coverage, Honestly
All 40 topics named in the IB Biology subject brief are here, in four themes: A Unity and diversity, B Form and function, C Interaction and interdependence, D Continuity and change. A further section covers skills and the scientific investigation. Every SL topic has at least 8 questions at SL and more at HL; topics that are HL only are marked. This is topic-level coverage in our own words. It is not the official guide, so check the current guide with your teacher.

### Learns How You Learn
- Short quizzes after every lesson. Wrong answers link straight to the idea you missed, with a one-line reason.
- A next-best step on the home screen that tells you why it was chosen: a gap to repair, a recall check, or the next idea in order.
- Mastery estimates for every concept, and recall prompts when something you knew is fading.
- Command-term coach: Define, Explain, Compare, Evaluate and 20 more, with model answers.
- Switch any time between Syllabus view and a build-led Real-World view. Progress is shared.

### See It Work: Labs
Osmosis and water potential, enzyme kinetics, Hardy-Weinberg and selection, protein synthesis in 3D, photosynthesis limiting factors, population models, genetics crosses with chi-squared, membrane transport, the action potential and the Calvin cycle. Change a setting and watch the biology respond.

### Build Something
Design a controlled enzyme experiment, model an ecosystem with a limiting factor, trace a trait from DNA to phenotype, design a sampling investigation. Use your own numbers and keep the result on your Made-it shelf.

### Internal Assessment Coach
Stages, a research-question checker, a variables planner and uncertainty basics. It helps you plan your own investigation and never writes it for you.

### Sl and Hl
Choose your level. HL-only topics and extension questions appear only at HL.

### Practice Formats
Quick mixed check, Paper 1A style multiple choice, Paper 1B style data-based sets and Paper 2 style short and extended response, with a mark report and study plan.

### Readable
Text size from 50 to 300 percent. An optional Other boards chip shows similar content in GCSE, A Level and AP courses.
